items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: Morgan and I, we had McCurdy's on Canal Street... our people played banjo and Morgan was playing a guitar

ctx.x: You didn't know Eddie Morgan, huh?
That's what I'm talking about Eddie Morgan. Oh, I see. The guitar player.
Oh, I see. Eddie Morgan, yeah. Well what was this, Paramount made your pictures, is that the back category?
